title: Does AI-Assisted Development Homogenize Software? An Empirical Study of Code Similarity, Quality, and Evolution
title_zh: AI辅助开发会使软件同质化吗？关于代码相似性、质量与演化的实证研究

paragraphs.en: 一项针对50个开源项目的实证研究发现，AI辅助开发并未导致代码同质化、质量下降或加速增长。 AI-assisted software development is evolving from interactive LLM assistance toward agentic systems that autonomously perform software engineering tasks, yet the effects of this shift remain insufficiently understood. We present an empirical study of 50 long-lived Java and Python open-source projects across three eras: pre-LLM, potentially LLM-assisted, and detected agentic development. Using snapshots from Software Heritage, we examine code similarity, software quality, and software evolution. Similarity is measured semantically through embedding-based cosine similarity and syntactically through CodeBLEU*. Quality is assessed with SonarQube metrics covering maintainability, complexity, reliability, and security. Evolution is characterized by annualized growth rates of LOC, functions, classes, files, and statements, and by commit activity in the three months preceding each snapshot. Results show no consistent evidence of increased similarity as semantic and syntactic similarity decreased significantly in Java for both the LLM and agentic eras relative to the pre-LLM era, while Python showed no significant differences. Software quality remained largely stable, although the agentic era showed significantly lower code-smell and SQALE index densities. Structural growth was generally lower in the agentic era, particularly for files, whereas development activity increased moderately in Java, especially in commits and added lines. These findings challenge the assumption that LLM- and agent-assisted development necessarily homogenizes code, degrades quality, or accelerates growth.
paragraphs.zh: 一项针对50个开源项目的实证研究发现，AI辅助开发并未导致代码同质化、质量下降或加速增长。AI辅助软件开发正在从交互式LLM辅助演变为自主执行软件工程任务的智能体系统，但这一转变的影响尚不清楚。 我们对50个长期活跃的Java和Python开源项目开展了一项实证研究，涵盖三个时代：前LLM时代、可能使用LLM辅助的时代，以及检测到智能体开发的时代。 我们利用Software Heritage的快照，考察代码相似性、软件质量与软件演化。 相似性通过基于嵌入的余弦相似度进行语义度量，并通过CodeBLEU*进行句法度量。 质量采用SonarQube指标进行评估，涵盖可维护性、复杂度、可靠性和安全性。 演化通过LOC、函数、类、文件和语句的年化增长率，以及每次快照前三个月的提交活动来刻画。 结果显示，没有一致证据表明相似性增加：与前LLM时代相比，LLM时代和智能体时代Java的语义与句法相似性均显著下降，而Python则无显著差异。 软件质量总体保持稳定，但智能体时代的代码坏味密度和SQALE指数密度显著更低。 智能体时代的结构性增长总体较低，尤其是文件方面，而Java的开发活动温和增加，尤其体现在提交和新增行数上。 这些发现挑战了LLM辅助和智能体辅助开发必然导致代码同质化、质量下降或加速增长的假设。
